ledger.change: Cache npm dependencies keyed on package-lock.json with an `npm-default` fallback key; `lint` pushes the cache, other jobs pull it.
ledger.expected_effect: Fewer repeated package downloads per job; shorter `npm ci` phase. Effect is measured as runner-minutes (proxy) and pipeline duration (measured).
ledger.risk: Low. A stale cache cannot change what is installed because npm ci still verifies against the lockfile; a cache miss only falls back to a full download.

ledger.change: Documentation-only changes skip lint/test/build. An explicit `classify` job diffs the whole pushed range with git, fails safe to "code", and triggers the matching child pipeline (ci/child-*.gitlab-ci.yml). secret_detection always runs in the parent.
ledger.expected_effect: Three jobs avoided per docs-only pipeline at the cost of one short classify job. Effect is counted (jobs executed) and measured (duration).
ledger.risk: Low. Misclassification fails toward running everything; the changed-path list is printed in the classify job log; the docs allow-list is unit-tested (src/classify.js). Replaced GitLab `rules:changes`, which judged a merge commit by its first parent and skipped tests on a code change (showcase pipeline 2994150067).

ledger.change: workflow:rules so a commit on a branch with an open MR runs one pipeline instead of two.
ledger.expected_effect: Halves pipelines for MR commits. Counted at the project pipeline list; not part of the per-run comparison.

ledger.change: Measure energy per run and calculate SCI.
ledger.expected_effect: UNKNOWN until runner energy telemetry or a validated model with a documented boundary is available.
ledger.risk: Risk of overclaiming. Not applied: no defensible energy input exists for GitLab shared runners.

boundary: GitLab CI jobs of this project only, including child pipelines (classify, lint, test, build, docs_only_notice, secret_detection, collect_evidence, pages). Excludes developer machines, GitLab control plane, artifact storage, and network transfer.
limitations: Runner-minutes are a compute-time proxy, not an energy or carbon measurement.
GitLab shared runners expose no energy telemetry; energy per run is UNKNOWN.
Pipeline durations include variance from runner provisioning and network; medians over several runs are reported.
Only runs with the same change class, runner class and required-job set are compared.
